title: Gemma 4 E2B/E4B paired operating points and runtime boundaries
question: Under which measured task, format, runtime, hardware, output-length, context, and verification conditions do Gemma 4 E2B and E4B expose recurring capability, memory, latency, throughput, energy, MTP, and reliability trade-offs, and which symptoms remain attributable to conversion, runtime, harness, or device rather than the model alone?

inclusion_criteria: Prefer paired E2B/E4B methods with exposed versions, hardware, prompts or task pools, and metric denominators.
Retain primary issue and field evidence when it exposes an exact route, failure phase, and unresolved confounds.
Countersearch strong directions and preserve non-comparable forum numbers as no-fit rather than false recurrence.
exclusion_criteria: Do not attribute runtime, conversion, parser, context-state, or device symptoms to model-only behavior without controls.
Do not merge latency, throughput, memory, energy, output length, or accepted outcome into one efficiency score.
Do not treat nominal 128K context, MTP artifact existence, or multimodal weights as a deployment receipt.

generality_probe.rationale: The run probes whether a stable E2B/E4B direction survives different instruments while keeping contradictory or route-specific outcomes separate.

observations.statement: In UDAE v2's four-dataset, three-strategy, greedy batch-one instrument, E4B few-shot CoT reports 0.761 weighted accuracy, 3.677 s mean latency, 14.895 GB peak memory, and 25.850 tok/s versus E2B at 0.688, 5.997 s, 9.543 GB, and 31.747 tok/s; the result supports an E4B outcome / E2B memory-and-decode frontier but not a universal wall-time or utility ranking.

clusters.label: E4B outcome advantage and E2B resource advantage recur on separate axes
clusters.supported_scope: One controlled task study places E4B ahead on weighted outcomes while independent deployment measurements repeatedly place E2B lower on memory, decode time, or energy; E4B placement can also shift its own fit frontier.
transfer_limits: The sources do not share checkpoints, formats, runtimes, hardware, prompts, or accepted-outcome denominators.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No paired owner run combines output acceptance, TTFT, prefill, decode, memory, energy, thermal state, reliability, and termination.
clusters.next_action: Build an owner-weighted Pareto study with exact realizations rather than select a universal winner.

clusters.label: MTP benefit depends on output length and exact runtime stack
clusters.supported_scope: A controlled field origin shows about 1.9-2.1x long-form gains and near-zero short-form gains, while a second forum origin demonstrates that runtime/format mismatch prevents direct recurrence claims.
transfer_limits: No batch, concurrency, energy, or owner workload break-even study exists.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Exact assistant revisions, break-even length curve, multi-client behavior, and accepted output parity are incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Sweep output length, acceptance, draft depth, batch, and hardware on exact target/assistant pairs.

clusters.label: PLE correctness and placement are runtime-version operating surfaces
clusters.supported_scope: PLE affects architecture metadata, forward-graph correctness, and device placement; successful loading or effective-parameter labels cannot substitute for execution and residency evidence.
transfer_limits: Issue reports differ in maturity and no common runtime comparison exists.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Supported cross-runtime offload and a generic PLE semantic test are absent.
clusters.next_action: Require a runtime-specific PLE correctness and placement check for any admitted realization.

clusters.label: Reliability failures are route-specific and multi-owner rather than model-only
clusters.supported_scope: Conversion format, device backend, state management, numeric path, parser, runtime version, and package size repeatedly change terminal behavior for E2B/E4B.
transfer_limits: No population incidence or common fixture spans these origins.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: Maintainer-confirmed root causes, fixed-version reruns, exact package digests, and independent reproductions are incomplete.
clusters.next_action: Route each symptom to its exact converter/runtime/hardware/harness owner and require a fixed-version health rerun.

clusters.label: Nominal 128K context is not a usable-context receipt
clusters.supported_scope: Provider model capacity, route generation caps, state reliability, prefill peak memory, and placement are separate determinants of usable context.
transfer_limits: The retained sources do not run one common long-context correctness benchmark to 128K.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No paired mobile E2B/E4B long-context accuracy, memory, thermal, and completion study was found.
clusters.next_action: Measure a usable-context frontier per exact runtime subject rather than admitting the nominal model limit.

clusters.label: Exposed measurements still require separate subject and comparability audits
clusters.supported_scope: A study can expose useful results while mislabeling architecture, omitting exact realization identity, or presenting non-comparable rows; each defect narrows rather than automatically erases the evidence.
transfer_limits: This is a method pattern, not a score for source classes.
unresolved_configuration_gaps: No automatic rule can decide which semantic layer remains usable; owner review remains required.
clusters.next_action: Audit subject metadata, method, and comparison compatibility independently in future runs.

tensions.label: E4B task outcome versus E2B memory, throughput, and energy
tensions.analysis: The sources recur on a capability/resource Pareto direction but use incompatible realizations and no common accepted-outcome utility, so neither side dominates universally.
tensions.remaining_question: What is verified utility per memory, time, energy, and reliability budget on AoA workloads?

tensions.label: Long-form MTP acceleration versus short-form no gain
tensions.analysis: Both outcomes arise in the same environment and differ principally by output length/task, resolving the apparent contradiction as an amortization boundary.
tensions.remaining_question: Where is the break-even length under each owner traffic distribution and batch size?

tensions.label: Lower NPU watts versus lower GPU joules per token
tensions.analysis: Absolute power and energy per generated token have different denominators; the GPU consumes more watts but finishes more tokens per unit time in this setup.
tensions.remaining_question: Which objective matters under battery, latency, concurrency, and thermal constraints?

tensions.label: On-device artifact positioning versus runtime and conversion failures
tensions.analysis: Successful and failed points coexist because format, graph representation, placement, backend, and runtime version differ; neither side is a family-wide verdict.
tensions.remaining_question: Which exact packages and runtime versions pass owner admission on each target device?

tensions.label: Nominal 131K model context versus unclosed mobile usable-context evidence
tensions.analysis: Model position capacity, route generation cap, prefill memory, state rehydration, and correctness are different dimensions; the gap remains open rather than a pass or contradiction.
tensions.remaining_question: What long-context frontier completes reliably with verified retrieval and bounded thermal/memory state on a named mobile route?

tensions.label: Useful controlled measurements versus incorrect model architecture metadata
tensions.analysis: The outcome table and architecture interpretation are separable evidence layers; the metadata error narrows mechanism claims without automatically deleting measured aggregates.
tensions.remaining_question: Did the study's fallback realization differ between E2B and E4B in a way not exposed by the aggregate table?

method_pressures.pressure: A source can expose a useful method or measurement while misclassifying architecture or comparing different runtime realizations.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Audit subject metadata, realization compatibility, and measured outcome method as separate evidence layers; downgrade only the unsupported layer.

method_pressures.pressure: MTP speedup changes from material to neutral when output length no longer amortizes draft overhead.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Require target/assistant revision, runtime, hardware, draft settings, acceptance, output-length distribution, batch, and break-even curve.

method_pressures.pressure: Watts, joules per token, total energy, output-token count, quality, and accepted outcome produce different efficiency conclusions.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Retain metric, denominator, instrument boundary, output length, quality/acceptance, and excluded infrastructure for every energy claim.

method_pressures.pressure: Model, checkpoint, conversion, route, runtime, harness, device, parser, and operator protocol can each cause or expose a failure symptom.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Route symptoms to the narrowest controlled owner surface and forbid model-only causality without held-constant evidence.

method_pressures.pressure: Nominal context length is repeatedly mistaken for a route-level usable context that completes correctly within memory and thermal limits.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Measure usable context per realization with correctness, prefill, decode, peak memory, state continuity, thermal behavior, and completion reliability.

method_pressures.pressure: Model-reported or parser-accepted completion can materially overstate task success when post-conditions are not verified.
method_pressures.proposed_response: Separate requested, executed, artifact, verified, reported, and termination outcomes and retain the acceptance grader.

revisit_triggers: UDAE or another controlled study publishes exact per-model checkpoints, precision paths, per-item artifacts, variance, or a corrected common-instrument rerun.
vLLM, Transformers, llama.cpp, LiteRT-LM, or OpenVINO changes Gemma 4 PLE, MTP, graph, device-map, multimodal, context, or device support.
Any cited issue receives a maintainer-confirmed cause, fix, closure, or independent reproduction on a named version.
A paired E2B/E4B study combines accepted output, TTFT, prefill, decode, peak memory, context, energy, thermal behavior, retries, and termination.
An artifact-backed mobile run tests long-context correctness and completion materially beyond 8K toward the nominal 128K limit.
An AoA owner selects exact E2B/E4B realizations and workload utility for a canonical study.
